abstract: We extend the theory of bilateral vertical contracting to a double moral hazard setting in which upstream and downstream firms make complementary investments that enhance demand. Downstream firms make fixed investments to enter the downstream market, and contracts are private information and determined through simultaneous bilateral bargaining. We show that vertical mergers mitigate bilateral contracting externalities and hold‐up, thereby increasing complementary investments. If downstream products are either sufficiently distant or sufficiently close substitutes, a vertical merger benefits the merging firm, consumers, and the unintegrated downstream firm. For intermediate degrees of product differentiation, a case with linear demand and quadratic investment costs shows that consumers benefit if the marginal cost of investment is sufficiently low, as revealed, for example, by a high ratio of R&D investments to sales. We apply the model to a vertical merger in the computer industry.
title: Vertical Mergers With Bilateral Contracting and Upstream and Downstream Investment
title_zh: 纵向合并中的双边合同与上下游投资

abstract: We propose a Simulated Minimum Distance (SMD) estimator based on the Wasserstein distance for estimating parameters in economic models with intractable likelihoods, such as Agent-Based Models (ABM). This approach avoids the need for complex likelihood approximations and is robust even when model and data distributions have non-overlapping support. Simulating the two- and three-type Brock and Hommes (1998) asset pricing model, we show that the estimator is more accurate than a likelihood-based Bayesian benchmark, in particular in the estimation of the behavioral parameters. We conclude with an empirical application of the Brock and Hommes (BH) model to S&P 500 data. Overall, the Simulated Wasserstein Minimum Distance Estimator (SWMDE) offers a flexible and computationally efficient tool for structural estimation in models where likelihood-based inference is infeasible or unreliable.

title: Estimation of Agent-Based Models using the Wasserstein Distance

abstract: Urban areas face challenges in jointly addressing the global climate change and nature loss crises amidst the pursuit of socioeconomic development agendas. These trade-offs prompt the need to explore solutions for sustainable environmental and societal futures that balance diverse priorities. Nature-based solutions (NbS) are one such approach that can provide synergistic benefits for climate, nature, and society. This study employs geospatial approaches to mapping and identifying such benefits and trade-offs, serving as a foundation to guide further assessment and planning. Using Hong Kong as a case study, we model the carbon storage, road-based disturbance, and climate risk trade-offs under five land use change scenarios for 2030. The results demonstrate the stark losses in climate mitigation benefits when urban areas are expanded at extreme scales, but only moderate losses under current planned development schemes that may be mitigated by the implementation of NbS. Several key areas in Hong Kong are identified where these benefits are maximised, namely Mai Po, Chek Lap Kok, and Sai Kung. NbS opportunities can be further explored in those areas to enhance natural carbon stores, reshape built infrastructure for nature connectivity, mitigate coastal flood risks, among other benefits. The results provides an evidence foundation for implementing NbS to bridge climate and nature policy agendas with competing urbanisation priorities in Hong Kong and other urban areas globally.

abstract: The sustainable development of land resources in emerging economies is integral to global sustainability and has direct implications for its overall trajectory. Amid ongoing shifts in the global geopolitical and geoeconomic landscape, as well as accelerating cross-border industrial relocation, tensions between built-up land expansion and ecological conservation in emerging economies have become increasingly pronounced. However, relatively little research has examined the regional heterogeneity of land use conflicts in emerging economies or the interactions among their drivers. Drawing on a long-term land use dataset for Vietnam spanning 1985–2020, this study employs a land use conflict assessment model, the patch-generating land use simulation (PLUS) model, extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost), and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP). The analysis characterizes regional heterogeneity in land use conflicts and examines the nonlinear relationships, threshold effects, and interactive associations between these conflicts and their drivers. The results reveal that (1) land use conflicts in Vietnam exhibit pronounced north–south heterogeneity in both their spatial patterns and underlying drivers. Ecologically sensitive areas and economically advantaged regions constitute the principal areas where land use conflicts are particularly pronounced. (2) Among the drivers examined, place-specific drivers were generally more influential. Population density, the area of production space, terrain fragmentation, industrial agglomeration, and market access emerged as the principal drivers. These drivers exhibited pronounced nonlinear relationships with land use conflict, while their associated threshold ranges generally widened. Market access and land use rights showed inverted S-shaped relationships with land use conflict, whereas industrial agglomeration and informal regulation showed inverted U-shaped relationships. Although drought ranked relatively low in overall importance, it interacted strongly with terrain fragmentation, industrial agglomeration, land yield, and population density in shaping land use conflict. (3) Across the simulated scenarios, the sustainable development scenario, which accommodates both economic development and ecological conservation, emerges as a viable pathway for alleviating land use conflicts. These findings deepen understanding of land-resource use and potential tensions in Vietnam, thereby providing an evidence base for strategies to manage land use conflicts and advance sustainable urban development.

abstract: For many decades, urban planners regarded logistics land uses as incompatible with urban environments, a perspective that intensified environmental externalities and inefficiencies in freight transport. This article proposes an evaluative framework for analyzing logistics land-use policies in urban plans, grounded in fourteen guidelines identified in the literature. Using this framework, four master plans for Fortaleza were assessed over a six-decade period to examine how they addressed warehouse locations. The findings show that zoning consistently displaced logistics activities from the downtown area to peripheral zones, reinforcing logistics sprawl and environmental injustice. The study also highlights the lack of integration between local and regional policies and the recurrence of unsubstantiated proposals. It argues that urban planners should systematically apply the proposed evaluative framework to ensure the proper integration of logistics land-use policies into urban planning.
title: Integrating logistics into urban land use planning

abstract: Urban agglomerations, which are critical hubs of population density and industrial activity, face escalating carbon emissions challenges that threaten global climate goals. Despite their significance, comparative analyses of emission drivers across different tiered areas including national, regional, and sub-regional urban agglomerations remain scarce. We first investigated spatiotemporal emission patterns and clustering characteristics across five national, six regional, and eight sub-regional urban agglomerations in the first five years (20112015) and the next five years (20162020) utilizing global and local spatial autocorrelation techniques. We then quantified the response of carbon emissions across these urban agglomerations to multiple socioeconomic drivers using three spatial econometric models. The carbon emissions of the Yangtze River Delta (YRD), Central Plains (CP), and Hohhot-Baotou-Ordos-Yulin (HBOY) urban agglomerations were the highest at the national, regional, and sub-regional levels, respectively. The average growth rates of regional urban agglomerations exhibited upward trends after 2016, whereas the growth rates for national and sub-regional urban agglomerations gradually moderated over time. At the spatial level, higher total carbon emissions were recorded in the middle and southern cities of the HBOY urban agglomeration, the eastern and southwestern cities of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei (BTH) urban agglomeration, the eastern cities of the YRD urban agglomeration, and the southern cities of the Chengdu-Chongqing (CC) urban agglomeration. All nineteen urban agglomerations exhibited strong spatial dependence with significant clustering characteristics in the first five years and the next five years. Energy intensity and environmental pollution were significantly positively associated with the variability of carbon emissions across 19 urban agglomerations in China over ten years. Economic scale and government intervention showed significant positive associations primarily in the first five years. The negative association of trade openness with carbon emissions became increasingly prominent in the first five years. These findings emphasize the importance of formulating effective carbon reduction policies based on the unique characteristics of urban agglomerations and tailoring them to the local conditions. In addition, this integrated approach provides spatially nuanced insights for targeted policy design, supporting China’s national climate goals and global climate action.

abstract: Mandatory environmental disclosure has become an increasingly important policy instrument in global environmental governance, yet evidence on its real effects remains limited. Using China's 2021 statutory environmental disclosure (SED) reform as a quasi-natural experiment, this study examines the impact of the SED policy on corporate environmental governance investment. We use panel data from Chinese A-share-listed firms from 2017 to 2023 and apply a staggered difference-in-differences approach. The results show that the SED policy significantly increases corporate environmental governance investment. The effect is stronger when formal government regulation and informal media oversight operate synergistically and for firms with greater chronic physical risk awareness. It is also more pronounced in cities with weaker local environmental law enforcement or higher local economic growth pressure and among firms with lower financing constraints. The SED policy further improves substantive environmental disclosure and promotes firms' attainment of environmental certification and official recognition. These findings provide new evidence on the governance effects of SED and inform the design of mandatory environmental disclosure as an instrument of information-based environmental regulation.

abstract: We quantify the equilibrium impact of retail traders on the U.S. equity market within a structural model of asset demand. Estimating investor-specific demand curves, we find that Robinhood traders are fundamentally distinct from all other investors, including other households: their demand is the most elastic and tilts most strongly toward volatile and microcap stocks. Each dollar invested through Robinhood generates more than five dollars in aggregate equity repricing, exceeding hedge funds, other households, and all other investor types. We decompose the cross-sectional variation in stock returns during Robinhood’s growth surge in 2020 into investor-specific components and find that shifts in Robinhood traders’ latent demand drove 11% of small-cap return volatility despite their negligible aggregate wealth share. To explain these demand shifts, we show that Robinhood traders are the only investor group whose latent demand is well explained by attention proxies: their demand exhibits a V-shaped response to past returns and rises sharply with trading volume. Our findings suggest that the growth of retail trading platforms represents a fundamental shift in the composition of equity demand with equilibrium consequences disproportionate to retail investors’ share of aggregate wealth. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: P. van der Beck acknowledges financial support from the Swiss National Science Foundation. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.04854 .

abstract: Peatlands store nearly 30% of global soil carbon, yet face conversion pressure from agricultural expansion. Focusing on Alberta, Canada, we develop a spatial framework that integrates multi-source datasets with random forest modeling, permutation importance, prior-probability calibration, and multi-year inactivity detection to evaluate conversion risk, drivers, land-use stability, and carbon loss for cropland and pasture. From 1998–2024, 848 km² of peatlands were converted to cropland and 1001 km² to pasture, concentrated within the provincial “White Area” and along the White–Green boundary. Since the 2000s, agricultural expansion has shifted northward and outward from long-settled districts, placing peatlands near the White-Area margin in the Green Area at heightened future risk. Locational forces dominate: cropland conversion correlates more strongly with economic conditions and land endowment, whereas pasture expansion is more constrained by climate. Although pixel-level peak risk is higher for cropland, pasture occupies a larger medium-to-high risk footprint. Post-conversion agricultural use on peat is unstable: nearly half of peat-derived parcels later fall out of production—43.31% of peat cropland and 56.04% of peat pasture were inactive, defined as not classified as agriculture for ≥ 3 consecutive years during 2011–2024. Estimated cumulative peat-soil carbon losses were approximately 1.47 Tg C for cropland and 1.57 Tg C for pasture, with emission-factor-based 95% uncertainty ranges of 1.21–1.75 Tg C and 0.80–2.36 Tg C, respectively. Policies should make soil-carbon costs explicit in approvals that lower peat water tables, enforce peat type integrity in offsets, and target high-risk corridors; public funds are better directed to clustered retire-and-rewet of already inactive peat parcels.
title: Peatland vulnerability to agricultural expansion: Conversion risk, inactivity, and carbon loss

abstract: Climate change-intensified seawater intrusion creates a dual shock of transitory freshwater shortages and lasting soil degradation. We study its impacts on agricultural production in the Vietnamese Mekong Delta, a major rice exporter. Combining river salinity observations and detailed canal network data to map localized hydrological shocks, we find that salinity reduces rice yields but generates disproportionately larger declines in output and revenue. These losses are driven by a contraction in land under cultivation and limited substitution toward salt-resistant crops, pointing to constrained short-run adaptation. Using household and firm data, we further document reductions in own-farm employment alongside minimal transition to non-agricultural sectors, suggesting frictions in labor adjustment. Beyond income effects predicted by Engel curves, households reallocate expenditures toward healthcare and children’s schooling. The increase in schooling spending is driven by higher participation and may reflect shifts in opportunity costs, though we cannot rule out forward-looking responses.

abstract: In many social networks, an individual observes only a restricted local view of the full network structure. We study such local views under a partial information framework that models an individual's observations as a subgraph based on path length, and address the problem of estimating a general latent space model from a single individual's local view. Compared to the full network, the partial information network contains many missing edges and depends on a random, potentially sparse neighborhood, posing significant challenges for estimation. We propose a projected gradient descent algorithm for maximum likelihood estimation and establish theoretical guarantees for its convergence under both conditional likelihood and full likelihood settings. To characterize the quality of a local view, we introduce an imbalance measure as a theoretical and diagnostic quantity for assessing bias in a local view and show that it plays a central role in determining convergence rates and estimation error bounds. Using simulated networks, we demonstrate that satisfactory estimation is possible from a single local view. In an application to U.S. Congress cosponsorship networks, we show how the estimated latent positions reveal nuanced structure in legislators' social relationships.
title: Local Information for Global Network Estimation in Latent Space Models

abstract: Computing the (pre-)nucleolus of a coalitional game with transferable utility (TU game) is generally NP-hard. Therefore, no universal polynomial-time algorithm exists. However, polynomial-time algorithms exist for specific game classes. The most general approach in the literature is based on the ellipsoid method and Maschler’s approximation scheme. In contrast, we propose polynomial-time solvability by using a Fenchel-Moreau conjugation-based approach from convex analysis that applies the method of Meinhardt (2013) to compute a pre-kernel element. This method not only allows the computation of the pre-nucleolus for game classes with a singleton pre-kernel with a runtime complexity of O(n 3). It also works for game classes with a set-valued pre-kernel whenever the pre-nucleolus is a vertex or a separated point within the pre-kernel set. Finally, we focus on the replication of the pre-nucleolus in the sense of Meinhardt (2024) for a class of related games to demonstrate the versatility of the Fenchel-Moreau conjugation-based approach while referring to group algebra.
title: A Fenchel-Moreau Conjugation-Based Approach for Computing the Pre-Kernel/Pre-Nucleolus

abstract: We examine how funding deficit pressures shape the risk-taking of U.S. corporate defined-benefit pension plans and how targeted regulatory relief can mitigate these incentives. Using the 2012 Moving Ahead for Progress in the 21st Century Act reform, which temporarily eased funding pressure by revising discount rate calculations, we show that plans receiving greater relief significantly reduced their equity allocations and shifted toward safer assets. This derisking was most pronounced among active plans and those sponsored by more financially constrained firms. Our findings demonstrate that targeted regulatory relief can curb risk-taking incentives even without altering underlying economic conditions or financial reporting standards and shed light on the likely (and unlikely) frictions driving such behavior. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Funding: R. Pinto acknowledges financial support from the Lancaster University Management School Pump Prime Program. abstract: Screening decisions—choosing a costly action that reveals information about an unknown quality—can be crucial in various situations, such as hiring workers or designing policies. Choosing whether to screen can be difficult because it requires recognizing and trading off the benefits of information with the costs of getting it. We investigate whether people recognize when the benefits of screening dominate its costs and what causes them to choose otherwise. Our online experiment simulates a hiring scenario with an initial trial task. Participants can first reveal candidates’ quality at a small cost and then choose which candidate to hire. Most participants choose the dominated task that does not reveal the candidates’ quality, and this mistake persists even with experience and feedback. We show that this insufficient screening is driven by failures to anticipate inference and plan the full strategy.
abstract_zh: 筛选决策——即选择一项 costly action（代价高昂的行动）以揭示关于未知质量的信息——在多种情境中至关重要，例如招聘员工或设计政策。决定是否进行筛选可能很困难，因为这需要识别信息带来的收益与获取信息的成本，并在二者之间进行权衡。我们研究人们是否能认识到筛选的收益何时超过其成本，以及是什么导致他们做出其他选择。我们的在线实验模拟了一个带有初始试用任务的招聘场景。参与者可以先以较小的成本揭示候选人的质量，然后选择聘用哪位候选人。大多数参与者选择了不揭示候选人质量的被支配任务，而且即使经过经验和反馈，这一错误仍然存在。我们表明，这种筛选不足是由未能预见推断并规划完整策略所驱动的。
title: Failures of contingent reasoning in screening decisions
title_zh: 筛选决策中条件推理的失败

abstract: Does the monetary–fiscal policy mix that stabilizes an economy depend on how many of its people are outside the financial system? I develop a two-agent New Keynesian model calibrated to Ghana where financially included (FI) households hold public debt and transact through mobile money. In contrast, financially excluded (FE) households live hand to mouth. The central result is distributional. The fiscal regime determines who bears the cost of monetary policy, which falls on FI households when the government finances deficits and on FE households when it stabilizes debt. The welfare of both households moves in opposition; aggregate models conceal a conflict that widens sharply with exclusion. The ratio of variance in included to excluded welfare increases from 1.3 to 7.0 as the excluded share increases from 60 to 80 percent. Moreover, where labor markets are flexible, as in largely informal economies, the same interaction governs whether a stable equilibrium exists. As financial inclusion deepens and labor markets formalize in developing economies, the policy mix that stabilizes an economy and shares risk fairly must change with it.
abstract_zh: 稳定经济的货币—财政政策组合是否取决于有多少人处于金融体系之外？我构建了一个针对加纳校准的两主体新凯恩斯模型，其中金融纳入（FI）家庭持有公共债务并通过移动货币进行交易。相比之下，金融排斥（FE）家庭则过着手到口的生活。核心结果是分配性的。财政制度决定了谁承担货币政策的成本：当政府为赤字融资时，成本落在FI家庭身上；当政府稳定债务时，成本落在FE家庭身上。两类家庭的福利呈相反方向变动；总量模型掩盖了一种冲突，而这种冲突随着排斥程度的上升而急剧扩大。随着被排斥比例从60%上升到80%，纳入家庭与排斥家庭福利方差之比从1.3增加到7.0。此外，在劳动力市场灵活的情况下，如在 largely informal economies 中，同样的相互作用决定了是否存在稳定均衡。随着发展中经济体金融纳入加深、劳动力市场正规化，稳定经济并公平分担风险的政策组合也必须随之改变。
title: Financial exclusion, fiscal regimes, and the incidence of monetary policy
title_zh: 金融排斥、财政制度与货币政策的影响范围

abstract: This paper examines how local universities can help close the gender gap in higher education arising from women’s greater geographic mobility barriers. Using the opening of new universities in the 1960s and 1970s in West German regions which previously lacked universities and individual-level survey data from the National Educational Panel Study (NEPS) for cohorts born 1944–1960, I examine how proximity to universities affects women’s educational decisions. First, I descriptively document women’s low regional mobility in post-war West Germany along with their low educational attainment. Second, in the main causal analysis, I exploit the university expansion in a difference-in-differences (DiD) strategy, comparing regions which experienced a university opening within commuting distance to those where no university was opened. Women benefited more than men from nearby openings, reducing the local gender gap in university education by about 74%. Local universities also affected women’s pre-tertiary education decisions, increasing high school graduation rates. Third, I provide descriptive evidence that universities increased participation not only by reducing moving costs but also through other channels, likely including greater visibility of and information about higher education. This paper highlights how public policy can reduce regional inequality and foster higher education participation, demonstrating that higher-education-stage interventions can influence pre-tertiary decisions and expand the policy toolkit beyond early childhood.
abstract_zh: 本文考察地方大学如何帮助缩小因女性面临更大地理流动障碍而产生的高等教育性别差距。利用20世纪60年代和70年代在西德此前没有大学的地区新设大学这一事件，以及国家教育追踪研究（NEPS）中1944—1960年出生队列的个体层面调查数据，我考察了靠近大学如何影响女性的教育决策。首先，我以描述性方式记录了战后西德女性较低的区域流动性及其较低的教育获得水平。其次，在主要因果分析中，我采用双重差分（DiD）策略利用大学扩张，比较在通勤距离内经历大学开设的地区与未开设大学的地区。女性从附近大学开设中的获益大于男性，使当地大学教育性别差距缩小约74%。地方大学还影响了女性的高等教育前教育决策，提高了高中毕业率。第三，我提供描述性证据表明，大学不仅通过降低迁移成本，还通过其他渠道提高了参与率，可能包括高等教育更高的可见度和更多相关信息。本文强调公共政策如何能够减少区域不平等并促进高等教育参与，表明高等教育阶段的干预可以影响高等教育前决策，并将政策工具包扩展到幼儿期之外。
title: Women’s missing mobility and the gender gap in higher education: Evidence from Germany’s university expansion
title_zh: 女性流动性缺失与高等教育中的性别差距：来自德国大学扩招的证据

abstract: Non-white leaders remain underrepresented in top public-sector positions, and their absence has been linked to persistent racial gaps in the bureaucracy. This paper investigates whether electing a non-white mayor affects the share of non-white managers in the Brazilian public sector. We leverage a close-election regression discontinuity design combined with a novel dataset on candidates’ race, constructed by applying face-classification algorithms to the photographs of all candidates in Brazil’s 2004–2016 municipal elections. On average, electing a non-white mayor does not significantly increase the share of non-white managers, although positive effects emerge in elections where the racial contrast between candidates is especially pronounced. We develop a search-theoretic framework of public-sector hiring and document limited differentiation in the observable recruitment pools of white and non-white mayors, together with little systematic evidence of race-contingent hiring standards. Our findings suggest that evidence from the United States may not readily generalize to settings with more fluid racial boundaries and greater overlap in recruitment networks across racial lines.
abstract_zh: 非白人领导者在公共部门高层职位中仍然代表性不足，其缺席与官僚体系中持续存在的种族差距相关。本文研究选举非白人市长是否会影响巴西公共部门中非白人管理者的比例。我们采用接近选举的回归断点设计，并结合一个关于候选人种族的新颖数据集，该数据集通过将人脸分类算法应用于巴西2004—2016年市政选举所有候选人的照片构建而成。平均而言，选举非白人市长并未显著提高非白人管理者的比例，尽管在候选人之间种族对比尤为明显的选举中会出现正向效应。我们构建了一个公共部门招聘的搜索理论框架，并记录了白人市长与非白人市长在可观察招聘池中的有限差异，同时几乎没有系统性证据表明存在依种族而定的招聘标准。我们的发现表明，来自美国的证据可能不易推广到种族边界更为流动、跨种族招聘网络重叠更大的环境。
title: Do black politicians matter? Political leadership and racial composition in top public sector positions
title_zh: 黑人政治家重要吗？公共部门高层职位的政治领导与种族构成

abstract: European integration is now faced with the question of strategic autonomy. Against this backdrop, this paper has three objectives. First, it uses disaggregated trade data and established empirical methods to assess the benefits of European integration on trade among the members of the European Union (EU) as well as on trade between EU members and non-member countries, including non-members that are part of the Single Market. Second, it evaluates the costs of EU strategic autonomy – implying not trading with “riskier” partners. Third, it asks whether deeper integration within the EU can alleviate these costs. The paper shows that the gains from European integration are substantial, albeit heterogeneous across Member States, non-members, and sectors, and that the costs of strategic autonomy can be offset by deeper, but comparatively more modest, integration efforts within the European Union.
abstract_zh: 欧洲一体化当前面临战略自主的问题。在此背景下，本文有三个目标。第一，运用分解贸易数据和既有实证方法，评估欧洲一体化对欧盟成员国之间贸易以及对欧盟成员国与非成员国（包括属于单一市场的非成员国）之间贸易的益处。第二，评估欧盟战略自主的成本——这意味着不与“风险较高”的伙伴进行贸易。第三，探讨欧盟内部更深层次的一体化能否缓解这些成本。本文表明，欧洲一体化带来的收益是巨大的，尽管在成员国、非成员国和部门之间呈现异质性，而战略自主的成本可以通过欧盟内部更深层次但相对更为温和的一体化努力来抵消。
title: Reassessing the benefits of European integration and the European Union’s ability to achieve strategic autonomy
title_zh: 重新评估欧洲一体化的益处与欧盟实现战略自主的能力

abstract: We introduce a new non-manipulability axiom called worst-case strategy-proofness (WCSP). This axiom is weaker than strategy-proofness and stronger than non-obvious manipulability-worst (NOM-worst) by Troyan and Morrill (2020). WCSP focuses on non-manipulability in a worst-case scenario. We examine the implications of WCSP in a voting model. Although many voting rules, such as the plurality rule, the Borda rule, and the Dowdall rule, satisfy NOM-worst, they violate WCSP. We obtain a necessary and sufficient condition for the anti-plurality rule with fixed-order tie-breaking to satisfy WCSP in terms of the numbers of agents and alternatives.
title: Worst-case strategy-proofness
title_zh: 最坏情况策略防伪性

abstract: I introduce value-dependent spite into first-price all-pay auctions and demonstrate that it leads to overbidding. Unlike in first- and second-price winner-pay auctions, value-dependent spite does not change the basic curvature of equilibrium bids: they remain convex. Nonetheless, value-dependent spite predicts different overbidding patterns from those predicted by value-independent spite. My main result highlights that, for low values, equilibrium bids when spite is value-dependent are closer to the non-spiteful benchmark than when spite is value-independent. Using approximations, I show that this result is strengthened when the relationship between a bidder’s value and her degree of spite is convex and weakened when it is concave.
abstract_zh: 本文将价值依赖型恶意引入第一价格全支付拍卖，并证明其会导致过度出价。与第一价格和第二价格赢家支付拍卖不同，价值依赖型恶意不会改变均衡出价的基本曲率：均衡出价仍保持凸性。尽管如此，价值依赖型恶意所预测的过度出价模式与价值独立型恶意所预测的不同。本文的主要结果表明，对于低价值情形，当恶意是价值依赖型时，均衡出价比恶意是价值独立型时更接近无恶意基准。通过近似分析，本文表明当竞标者价值与其恶意程度之间的关系为凸时，这一结果会增强；当该关系为凹时，这一结果会减弱。
title: Value-dependent spite in first-price all-pay auctions
title_zh: 一价全支付拍卖中基于价值的恶意行为

abstract: Hedge funds often use leverage provided by prime brokers to enhance their investment returns. We investigate how prime brokers’ capital constraints impact the performance of connected hedge funds. At the hedge fund level, we construct a measure for prime brokers’ balance sheet constraints using the capital requirements under the Basel III framework. We document that tighter balance sheet constraints of prime brokers lead to lower future return, alpha, volatility, Sharpe ratio, and information ratio of the hedge funds. These findings are consistent with an analytical model in which prime brokers respond to balance sheet constraints by increasing leverage cost or decreasing leverage provision to hedge funds. We show that the estimated effects are more pronounced for hedge funds with higher leverage demand elasticities and during more capital-binding periods. Our results reveal the real effects of bank regulation on connected financial institutions via the services of prime brokers. We conduct empirical tests for our identification strategy and support our findings via multiple robustness checks.
abstract_zh: 对冲基金常利用主经纪商提供的杠杆来提升投资回报。本文研究主经纪商的资本约束如何影响与其关联的对冲基金业绩。在对冲基金层面，我们基于巴塞尔III框架下的资本要求构建了主经纪商资产负债表约束的度量指标。我们发现，主经纪商更紧的资产负债表约束会导致对冲基金未来回报、阿尔法、波动率、夏普比率和信息比率下降。这些发现与一个分析模型一致：在该模型中，主经纪商面对资产负债表约束时，会提高杠杆成本或减少对对冲基金的杠杆供给。我们表明，对于杠杆需求弹性更高的对冲基金以及在资本更受约束的时期，估计效应更为显著。我们的结果揭示了银行监管通过主经纪商服务对关联金融机构产生的实际效应。我们针对识别策略进行了实证检验，并通过多项稳健性检验支持我们的发现。
title: The effect of prime brokers’ balance sheet constraints on hedge fund performance: Evidence from the GSIB surcharge
title_zh: 主经纪商资产负债表约束对对冲基金业绩的影响：来自全球系统重要性银行附加费的经验证据

abstract: This paper examines the political consequences of introducing the welfare state targeted at blue-collar workers in nineteenth-century Germany. I conceptualize Bismarck’s reform as an accommodation strategy to combat the Socialist Party as an emerging challenger party. The result of a difference-in-differences design shows that the Socialist Party benefited in elections due to the reform. The mechanism analysis points to the socialists’ issue ownership by adopting a stronger reformist stance. The results are not driven by other political and economic channels related to the reform.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了19世纪德国针对蓝领工人引入福利国家的政治后果。我将俾斯麦的改革概念化为一种旨在打击作为新兴挑战者政党的社会党的安抚策略。双重差分设计的结果表明，社会党因该改革而在选举中获益。机制分析指向社会党人通过采取更强的改良主义立场而实现的问题所有权。该结果并非由与该改革相关的其他政治和经济渠道所驱动。
title: Bismarck’s Welfare State and the Socialists
title_zh: 俾斯麦的福利国家与社会主义者

abstract: Are the effects of tax aversion on labor supply symmetric? In a real-effort online experiment, participants are exposed to manipulated wages and taxes after first experiencing the same reference wage. We find no significant differences in their productivity; however, we find asymmetries in fairness perceptions of the treatments. When net wages are decreasing, we find that tax increases are viewed as significantly more unfair than equivalent wage decreases. When net wages are increasing, we find that tax decreases are viewed as more fair than equivalent wage increases, though we do not find statistically significant differences in effect sizes and the gap in fairness perceptions is smaller compared to when net wages are decreasing. Connecting our labor supply results to our results on fairness perceptions, we find no evidence of working behavior significantly varying with these asymmetric fairness perceptions.
abstract_zh: 税收厌恶对劳动供给的影响是否对称？在一项真实努力在线实验中，参与者在首先经历相同的参考工资后，面对被操纵的工资和税收。我们发现其生产率无显著差异；然而，我们发现各处理在公平感知上存在不对称性。当净工资下降时，我们发现税收增加被视为比等量工资减少显著更不公平。当净工资上升时，我们发现税收减少被视为比等量工资增加更公平，尽管我们未发现效应量在统计上显著差异，且与净工资下降时相比，公平感知的差距更小。将我们的劳动供给结果与公平感知结果相联系，我们未发现证据表明工作行为会随这些不对称的公平感知而显著变化。
title: Asymmetric labor supply responses to taxation
title_zh: 劳动供给对税收的非对称反应

abstract: Large manufacturers may obtain better terms from foreign suppliers when they account for an important share of demand. We study this buyer power using matched customs and production data for Chinese manufacturing firms from 2000 to 2007. Measuring buyer power for each imported product and source country reveals substantial differences across firms that aggregate input measures conceal. Pure processing‐trade firms have higher average buyer power, whereas pure ordinary‐trade firms experience larger increases over time. Within firms, buyer power is higher when processing trade accounts for a larger share of imports and when input tariffs are lower. Together, these patterns connect firms' purchasing leverage to their trade regime and exposure to input tariffs.
abstract_zh: 大型制造商在需求中占据重要份额时，可能从外国供应商处获得更有利的条件。我们利用2000年至2007年中国制造业企业的匹配海关与生产数据，研究这种买方力量。针对每种进口产品和来源国衡量买方力量，揭示了企业间存在显著差异，而这些差异被加总的投入品指标所掩盖。纯加工贸易企业的平均买方力量较高，而纯一般贸易企业的买方力量随时间增长幅度更大。在企业内部，当加工贸易占进口比重更大且投入品关税更低时，买方力量更强。综合来看，这些模式将企业的采购议价能力与其贸易方式和投入品关税暴露联系起来。
